edition.en: Chapter 1 of the Zhuangzi, complete, as given on Chinese Wikisource; the inline notes on variant readings and the editorial brackets are removed.
edition.zh: 《庄子》第一篇全文，据维基文库；删去行内异文注与校勘括号。

basis.en: Classical Chinese text of the Warring States period; the author died about 286 BCE.
basis.zh: 战国古典文本，作者约卒于公元前 286 年。

note.en: The opening chapter of the Zhuangzi, and its most famous: a fish that becomes a bird, a quail that laughs at it, and a useless tree that no axe will touch. It is shelved complete. Notice how the argument keeps changing scale, from the ninety thousand miles of the Peng to a cup of water poured into a hollow in the floor.
note.zh: 《庄子》开篇，也是最有名的一篇：化而为鸟的鱼，笑它的斥鴳，还有斧斤不加的无用之树。全文上架。留意论说不断变换尺度：从鹏的九万里，到倒在坳堂上的一杯水。

excerpt.orig: 北冥有魚，其名爲鯤。鯤之大，不知其幾千里也，化而爲鳥，其名爲鵬。
excerpt.en: In the northern darkness there is a fish whose name is Kun. The Kun is so large that no one knows how many thousand miles it measures. It changes and becomes a bird whose name is Peng.
excerpt.zh: 北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也，化而为鸟，其名为鹏。

gloss.en: 冥 is read as 溟: the dark, deep sea of the far north.
gloss.zh: 冥：通“溟”，幽深的大海。

gloss.en: In the old dictionary Erya, 鯤 means fish roe: Zhuangzi gives the largest fish the name of the smallest thing.
gloss.zh: 《尔雅》释“鲲”为鱼子；庄子却用这个最小之物的名字来称最大的鱼。

gloss.en: Qi Xie: the name of a book of marvels, or by another reading, of a man who told them.
gloss.zh: 齐谐：书名，一说人名，记载怪异之事。

gloss.en: 摶: to rise by wheeling round. 扶搖: a whirlwind.
gloss.zh: 抟：盘旋而上。扶摇：自下而上的旋风。

gloss.en: 息 can mean rest or wind: it flies six months before it rests, or it leaves on the great wind of the sixth month.
gloss.zh: 息：一解为休息，一飞六个月才停；一解为风，乘六月的大风而去。

gloss.en: 野馬: heat haze, the shimmering vapour that runs over the fields in spring like wild horses.
gloss.zh: 野马：春日田野间浮动的雾气，奔腾如野马。

gloss.en: A hollow in the floor of a hall.
gloss.zh: 坳堂：堂上低洼的地方。

gloss.en: 夭閼: to check, to hold back.
gloss.zh: 夭阏：阻拦、遏止。

gloss.en: 蜩: a cicada. 鷽鳩: a small dove.
gloss.zh: 蜩：蝉。鸴鸠：一种小斑鸠。

gloss.en: 朝菌: a mushroom born at dawn and dead by night. 晦 is the last day of the lunar month, 朔 the first.
gloss.zh: 朝菌：朝生暮死的菌类。晦是农历每月最后一天，朔是第一天。

gloss.en: A cicada that lives a single summer and never sees a whole year.
gloss.zh: 蟪蛄：寒蝉，生命不满一年。

gloss.en: Pengzu: a man of legend said to have lived about eight hundred years.
gloss.zh: 彭祖：传说中的长寿者，相传活了八百岁。

gloss.en: Tang founded the Shang dynasty; Ji was a wise man of his court. Their dialogue is told at length in the Liezi chapter ‘Questions of Tang’.
gloss.zh: 汤：商朝开国君主。棘：汤时的贤人。二人的问答在《列子·汤问》中有更详细的记述。

gloss.en: The bare-haired lands: the far north where nothing grows (髮, hair, here the grass and trees of the earth).
gloss.zh: 穷发：不毛之地；发，指大地上的草木。

gloss.en: A quail of the marshes; 斥 is a small salt marsh.
gloss.zh: 斥：小泽。鴳：鹌鹑一类的小鸟。

gloss.en: Song Rongzi: usually identified with Song Xing, a Warring States thinker who taught that to be insulted is no disgrace.
gloss.zh: 宋荣子：一般认为即宋钘，战国思想家，主张“见侮不辱”。

gloss.en: Liezi: Lie Yukou, a Daoist master said to travel on the wind. The book that bears his name is on this shelf.
gloss.zh: 列子：列御寇，相传能乘风而行。以他命名的《列子》也在本书架上。

gloss.en: The six energies: yin, yang, wind, rain, dark and light. 辯 is read as 變, change.
gloss.zh: 六气：阴、阳、风、雨、晦、明。辩：通“变”。

gloss.en: The perfect person, the spirit person, the sage: three names for one who depends on nothing.
gloss.zh: 至人、神人、圣人，都是指无所依待的人。

gloss.en: Xu You: a hermit of legend who refused the empire and, it was said, washed out his ears after hearing the offer.
gloss.zh: 许由：传说中的隐士，尧让天下给他，他不受，据说还到颍水边洗耳。

gloss.en: 尸: to occupy a place without doing its work, like the 尸, the living stand-in for the dead at a sacrifice.
gloss.zh: 尸：占着位子而不做事；尸本指祭祀时代替死者受祭的人。

gloss.en: 尸祝: the priest who presides over the offerings. 樽俎: the wine vessels and meat stands of the rite.
gloss.zh: 尸祝：主持祭祀的人。樽俎：盛酒的器皿和盛肉的礼器。

gloss.en: Jie Yu: the madman of Chu, who also sings his warning to Confucius in Analects 18.5.
gloss.zh: 接舆：楚国的狂人，《论语·微子》中曾唱歌讽劝孔子。

gloss.en: Mount Gushe (射 is read ye), a mountain of legend; 藐, far off.
gloss.zh: 姑射（yè）山：传说中的神山。藐：遥远。

gloss.en: 蘄: to seek. 亂 here means order, as it sometimes does in early texts.
gloss.zh: 蕲：求。乱：治理，古汉语中“乱”有时作“治”讲。

gloss.en: 資: to trade in. 章甫: a ceremonial cap of the Shang people, kept up in Song.
gloss.zh: 资：贩运。章甫：殷商时的礼帽，宋国沿用。

gloss.en: 龜 is read jun here: to crack and chap with cold.
gloss.zh: 龟（jūn）：皮肤冻裂。

gloss.en: To bleach floss silk by beating it in water; 絖 is silk floss.
gloss.zh: 洴澼：在水中漂洗。絖：丝絮。

gloss.en: 樽 here is a float of gourds tied at the waist for crossing water.
gloss.zh: 樽：腰舟，系在腰间用来渡水的葫芦。

gloss.en: The village of nothing at all: a place where there is nothing, and so nothing to harm.
gloss.zh: 无何有之乡：什么都没有的地方，因而也没有什么能伤害。
